title: Gun keys renumbered, Rocket class on key 0
why: His order 2026-10-18: get rid of the marksman rifle, move everything past it down a number, and add a rocket launcher as 0. The Marksman class leaves the gun keys: sniper is 7, energy is 8, the Rocket class is key 0 and key 9 does nothing. Zoom to 100 moves to the numpad 0. A saved key table that holds the marksman class keeps its order, loses the marksman and gains the rocket.
now: Gun keys moved down one past the marksman: 7 sniper, 8 energy. Key 0 is set aside for the Rocket Launcher.
